=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:649-660 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test extraction includes ci.yml's failure-summary block, so its extracted range differs from the release-gate workflows.
  WHY: The assertion fails for both release-gate workflows because their extracted loops do not include the ci.yml-only summary block.

- Requirement: Issue #6885 asks that a failing orchestrate-poll shard names its failing tests in `::error::` annotations so check-failure-triage can read them; the PR description (AD-2) confirms the same shard judgment loop is added to ci.yml, mark-stable.yml, and test-and-mark-stable.yml.
  Expected change site: The shard judgment loop in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (lines 1841-1866)
  Evidence of absence: ci.yml already contains a failure-summary block (added by issues #6889 / #6946, around the `if [ "${shard_failures}" -ne 0 ]; then` branch starting at line 1868) that prints `::error::orchestrate-poll shard ${failed_shard} failing tests: ${failed_test_names% }` for each failed shard and `::error::orchestrate-poll shard ${failed_shard} exit ${shard_rc} failed tests: ${shard_failed_list}` for each `shard_failure_summary`, plus the tally `::error::${shard_failures} orchestrate-poll shard(s) failed.`. The release-gate workflows have no such block. After this PR, ci.yml therefore emits the failing-test names twice per failed shard (once from the new per-shard code, once from the failure-summary block), while the release gates emit them once. GitHub's checks page shows only the first 10 `::error::` annotations per step, so the duplicated per-shard annotations crowd the failure-summary tally out of the UI surface for multi-shard failures. The diff does not deduplicate, gate, or document this divergence.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- Requirement: The changelog headline should describe the user-visible behaviour change accurately across all three workflows.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/6885-poll-shard-fail-annotations.md, the headline paragraph (line 3).
  Evidence of absence: The headline says "A failing orchestrate-poll test shard now names its failing tests, or prints the end of its log, in `::error::` annotations, in CI and in both release gates." It does not mention that ci.yml already had a per-shard failing-test annotation path (the failure-summary block) and that the new code therefore produces duplicate annotations in ci.yml but not in the release gates. Operators reading the changelog cannot predict that ci.yml annotations will outnumber release-gate annotations for the same shard outcome.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
